text:
morgan: FYI starting coordinated cutover in 22m (API/runtime/console/router). Pins: API=3.1.2, runtime=kernel-qt2.1, console=6.2.0, router=header-slab-v2. Plan is warmup -> canary -> pause for KV gate -> ramp. Any immediate concerns?

alex: recommend initial warmup at 2% for 2m, then canary 10% for 4m, pause for KV and CSP inspection, then ramp 50% -> 100%. leave a 5m cushion between 50% and 100%.

emily: console will flip asset flag at +9m and set CDN TTL to 40s for 15m. Note: new CSP header needs router passthrough config; sasha pls confirm. I'll update release notes with the asset and CSP caveat.
sasha: confirmed router change queued. I'll watch header passthrough logs during the 10% canary. If we see header drop >0.2% revert router immediately.
jay: observability: preflight checks and canary healthchecks set. thresholds: p95 latency >160ms OR error rate >0.8% sustained 90s -> rollback. I'll post canary metrics each stage.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by morgan: "crosscut-8034567890". Start in 22m. Pins applied. Pause at 10% with manual gate PAUSE_FOR_KV. Rollback window 60m. To cancel: `/deploy cancel crosscut-8034567890`.
morgan: rollback order: runtime -> api -> router -> console unless router/CSP breaks client flows then router first. Rollback targets: runtime=kernel-qt2.0, api=3.1.1, router=revert-header-slab, console=6.1.x.
alex: agree. runtime-first helps cut kernel-induced tokenization regressions.
emily: console rollback requires CDN purges (3-6m). keep console last.
sasha: will approve router unpin only after 10% canary shows header passthrough intact for 5m.
jay: I'll run T-5 smoke: `curl -sS -I https://api.redwood.test/health | grep X-Runtime-Kernel` and `curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq -r .status`. Posting results.
morgan: add manual gate at 10% and 50% requiring alex or sasha approval to resume. deploy-bot noted.
deploy-bot: PAUSE_AT_10 set; manual resume `/deploy resume crosscut-8034567890`. Streaming updates here during rollout.
morgan: thanks everyone. i'll kick off at scheduled time and post stage outputs here. ping this thread to trigger rollbacks or emergency fixes. :rocket:
